request.title: Fiddle, when he calls
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. This is a still for a cinematic trailer: keep the main subject centred slightly above the middle with a strong silhouette, and keep the lower third darker and uncluttered so a title can sit over it. Scene: a storm at sea. Fiddle stands on the prow of a small ship holding a conch shell to his lips as a colossal wave rears up behind him and a gigantic whale breaches through it. Spectacular and joyful. Characters: Fiddle: a small green-skinned goblin ranger with large pointed ears, leather armour hung with clover charms and dice.

references.role: Character appearance reference for Fiddle. Preserve the face, hair, build, colours and outfit shown; ignore the background, base and any interface elements.

request.alt: Fiddle blows a conch on a ship's prow as a gigantic whale breaches through a towering wave.
